title: Steins;Gate
native_title: シュタインズ・ゲート
source: Steins;Gate visual novel by 5pb./Nitroplus (true ending), as adapted by the anime.
world: Self-proclaimed mad scientist Rintaro Okabe ('Hououin Kyouma') runs the Future Gadget Laboratory in Akihabara with his childhood friend Mayuri and hacker Daru. Their microwave-phone accidentally sends messages to the past (D-Mails), changing reality. Okabe alone keeps his memories across worldlines and must undo every change to save both Mayuri and Kurisu Makise, reaching the Steins;Gate worldline. Slow-burning sci-fi thriller with lots of nerd humour.
power_system: No magic. D-Mails send texts to the past; the Time Leap Machine sends memories back. Okabe's Reading Steiner lets him remember previous worldlines.
